nodes.description: Public payable fallback that deploys arbitrary bytecode supplied in msg.data via inline assembly create2.
Local bytes memory variable assigned from msg.data and used as the create2 init code.
Local address variable that receives the result of the create2 deployment.
Inline assembly create2 deploys attacker-controlled bytecode with callvalue() and salt 0.

edges.reason: The public fallback directly executes the create2 assembly deployment without any caller restriction, allowing arbitrary callers to deploy attacker-controlled bytecode.
The fallback assigns msg.data to the local code variable.
The local code bytes are passed as the create2 init code.
The address returned by create2 is assigned to the local addr variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Local bytes variable code is only used as the init code for the create2 unsafe operation.
Local address variable addr only receives and stores the create2 deployment result.
